version.approval_notes: Connects only to the KnobDeck desktop app over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1 (no other network requests). Source is not minified or bundled; it is src/background.js in https://github.com/Knobdeck/knobdeck-browser-companion. To exercise it, install KnobDeck and its Browser Controls plugin.

summary.en-US: Lets the KnobDeck dial and deck control this browser: tabs, windows, zoom, bookmarks and history, without keyboard shortcuts.
